scope: Static contract-shape cases for the command request/result pairs this file defines (ledger pldg-20260927-003-wand-scheduling: B-SQR-09 for the six scheduling commands, SQR-013, SQR-015, SQR-017; closure wave B-SQR-05 for cmd.runtime.automation_pause.set and the project pause record, SQR-018, DL-136). A passing case proves a shape only: no handler, catalogue admission, storage, event, timer or native dispatch, and not that the pause holds real dispatches (ATS-064).
